Faulkner was born in **New Albany, Mississippi**, not Oxford. Sources give his birth date as September 25, 1897, and a Mississippi historical marker in New Albany commemorates the birth ([hmdb.org](https://www.hmdb.org/m.asp?m=96769)). His family moved to Oxford, Mississippi, in 1902, and he lived there for most of his life ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Faulkner)).

He won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction twice, for *A Fable* (1955) and *The Reivers* (1963, awarded posthumously) ([Encyclopaedia Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/biography/William-faulkner); [Find a Grave](https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/328)). Some sources list the Nobel Prize as 1950, but it was 1949 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Faulkner)).
